metadata_used.title: Life on the Road — US Trip 2026
metadata_used.description: A 2:28 cinematic highlight reel of a 7-week US road trip, built from 282 personal phone clips. Epic Build direction: propulsive daily-life montage (gym, cooking, DIY van life, driving) building to hero landmark moments (Niagara Falls, a historic-reenactor field, a campfire, a sunset bridge crossing), scored to a free Pixabay orchestral track.

metadata.poster_frame_notes: Niagara Falls wide shot (IMG_1163.MOV, ~78s mark) or the sunset bridge crossing (video-1597_singular_display.MOV, final ~10s) are the strongest poster-frame candidates.
metadata.distribution_notes: Rendered at 1920x1080/30fps for YouTube per proposal. No captions/subtitles (music-driven, no narration, per approved proposal).
